summary: Parkevtate Vosianc's September 22 video argues Western Digital is a buying opportunity riding the agentic-AI storage boom. His key points: agentic AI systems create and store more data (great for WDC), customers are signing longer-term agreements extending to 2029-2031, which reduces cyclicality, improves planning visibility and justifies a higher multiple, and the company is charging higher prices with growing negotiating power amid favorable supply-demand dynamics. Revenues have recovered to $12.92B with management forecasting continued growth, and the growth comes with record margins — trailing-12-month operating margin of 35.6% (vs a 2019 peak of 19%) and ROIC of 84.75%, the highest in a decade. He expects margins to persist and possibly rise for the next 4-8 quarters before settling at a still-strong 20-40% ROIC. He addresses the peak-earnings concern: WDC trades at a forward P/E of just 13.8 (similar to 2024, pre-boom) precisely because investors assume peak earnings will collapse, but he revised his DCF free-cash-flow estimates ~2% higher and now sees the stock as undervalued with roughly 18% upside (the exact fair-value figure is garbled/missing in the auto-captions). He upgrades his conviction from low to medium on the longer-term agreements and reduced cyclicality. He also mentions Micron (reporting September 30 — he'll cover it in a members-only livestream), Sandisk, Samsung, and the broader memory/storage industry. Calls per supplied list: WDC BUY.
title: Is Western Digital an Undervalued Semiconductor Stock to Buy Right Now? | WDC STock Analysis
